b: I don’t know what you know. I don’t want what you want, see what you see, believe what you believe.
In fact, it’s the only way to be of service, to make a sale or to cause a change to happen.

Of course, we’re more intimate with our ideas, our products and our approach than anyone else. We have a noise in our head, a narrative and a point of view we’ve spent our whole lives creating. It’s naive to believe that anyone else is completely in sync with us.
And so, our only opportunity is to go where they are, not to demand that they come to us.

Practical empathy isn’t primarily an act of kindness (though it’s an essential component of kindness.) Instead, it’s a direct and straightforward path from here to there. It’s how we create action, learning and change.
Marketing is the simple and brave act of going to where someone else might be, and helping them get to where they hope to go.
